draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 45th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 7th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 101, well after his grade rank (45th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Trumaine Johnson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 passes defended in 2020, 9th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 53 career games and 22 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Weak spots: completion % allowed 85.7% (0th percentile), passer rating allowed 128.0 (3rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 51.1% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
